title: mimulus guttatus subsp. typicus
intro: Mimulus guttatus subsp. typicus, commonly known as the sticky monkey flower, is a plant species belonging to the phlox family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety and stress, and offering relief from insomnia. The health benefits of M. guttatus subsp. typicus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which possess therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its ability to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety by interacting with the brain's GABA receptors, making it a potential natural remedy for stress-related disorders.
